note: Every chat of run 14 (run 13 told as improvisation instructions, without the game's language; traps two long): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer. All of them were written improvisation by improvisation to the same instructions, under IMPROVISATIONS. What the instructions fix (how each improvisation goes, the traps, how interest moves) is shared by design and is not a template, and is not held against the set: list the improvisations it decides under excused and judge only what the writers made of it.

chat.variety.why: I set aside the shared move order (charm, wit, denial, dread, rescue, date), which the instructions fix. What the writers built on it is still close to one scene. All three open with Reuben's breezy line about her outfit or schedule tattoo. All three have Brick catch his four-second reply and call his mirror rehearsal. She reveals the ex who left over calendared fights and the cab she cried in after "sometime". He confesses that Delphine left because everything was a bit. It closes on an invite with travel buffers. Lines recur across all three chats (four seconds, mirror, cab/sometime, boxed rosé, travel buffer), and more recur in two (dishwasher-safe, $340 steamer, eleven days indoors). What lifts it off a 1 is texture: Carr's contract-law silence clause and 2038 fumble, Ali's chairs and pigs-in-a-blanket, Joel's ottoman and Q3 productivity.
